conditions.evidence: pediatric subjects with histologically approved high-grade glioma
conditions.label: high-grade glioma

output.population: Pediatric subjects with histologically approved high-grade glioma, including diffuse midline glioma and diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma, from Boston's Children Hospital and Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (n=61); infants under one month excluded.
output.summary: Retrospective multi-institutional collection of structural brain MRI (pre- and post-gadolinium T1, T2, T2-FLAIR) from pediatric patients with histologically confirmed high-grade glioma, forming a subset of a segmentation challenge dataset.
